descriptionMarkdown:
Style Benefit
Gunslinger Once per turn, you can reload a 
pistol without using an action.
Knife Rat
Your melee attacks with light 
weapons score a critical hit on 19-
20.
Chem-User
Once per long rest, inject combat 
chems as a bonus action. Gain 
+10 ft speed and advantage on 
Strength and Dexterity checks for 
1 minute. Afterwards, make a 
Constitution saving throw or gain 
one level of exhaustion.
Sump Ghost
You gain expertise in Stealth when 
in urban ruins, sewers, vents, 
tunnels, or industrial terrain.
